---
name: Accessibility
about: A message, embed, or control that's hard to use for some users
title: '[ACCESSIBILITY] '
labels: accessibility
---

**Where**
The command, modal, button, or message. Paste the current text or
a screenshot.

**The barrier**
What makes it hard to use, and for whom. Common cases here:
meaning carried only by emoji or color; a button label that means
nothing read aloud on its own; an embed whose structure is lost
when flattened to text; instructions that assume the user can see
a previous message.

**Proposed**
The revised wording or structure. For copy issues, write the
replacement text — that's usually the whole fix.

**Done when**
The information survives being read aloud, in order, with no
visual context.
